non-identifying-artifact-title-strings.why: Title is present and non-empty but identifies nothing about the page's content.

title-describes-secondary-not-primary-to.why: Title exists but names a peripheral block, not the page's overall purpose.

stale-in-family-wrong-instance-title.why: Title present but names wrong instance, so it misidentifies this page's content.

title-too-generic-to-distinguish-page-in.why: Site-name/template title is present but fails to distinguish this page from siblings.

title-loses-meaning-out-of-context.why: Title is present but too context-dependent to identify the page out of context.
